content_sections.heading: About Integrated Child Development Project Manpur
content_sections.text: Integrated Child Development Project Manpur is a project of the Women and Child Development Department in Gariaband district, Chhattisgarh. The vacancies are in Anganwadi centres under this project. The recruitment was announced by District Programme Officer Shri Varun Nagesh (श्री वरूण नागेश).

content_sections.heading: Integrated Child Development Project Manpur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notice gives only one deadline, 21 November 2026, for online applications.

content_sections.heading: Vacancies by Project / Block
content_sections.text: The 11 vacancies are spread over 11 Anganwadi centres under the Manpur project, one post at each centre. The only Anganwadi Worker post is at Jholarao; the other ten centres each have one Anganwadi Helper post. Most posts, 10 of 11, are Anganwadi Helper posts; Jholarao has the single Anganwadi Worker post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only women can apply for these posts. The notice sets the following conditions. Age limit (both posts): between 18 and 44 years. The notice does not state the date on which age is counted. Local residence: the applicant must be a local resident of the village, or of the same ward in the urban area, where the Anganwadi centre is located. This is compulsory for appointment. The notice does not mention any age relaxation or experience requirement; candidates should check the official notification for further eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Integrated Child Development Project Manpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Apply online through the e-Bharti portal (ई-भर्ती पोर्टल); the notice does not print the portal's web address. Submit the application between 5 November 2026 and 21 November 2026. Attach all the necessary certificates and documents with the application; this is compulsory. Applications are accepted only online. The notice does not list the individual documents.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the Manpur Anganwadi recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 11 vacancies: 1 Anganwadi Worker post and 10 Anganwadi Helper posts under Integrated Child Development Project Manpur.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 21 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Anganwadi Worker?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Anganwadi Worker is 12th pass or erstwhile 11th board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Anganwadi Helper?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for Anganwadi Helper is 8th board pass.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The applicant's age must be between 18 and 44 years, for both the Anganwadi Worker and Anganwadi Helper posts.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online through the e-Bharti portal between 5 and 21 November 2026, attaching all necessary certificates and documents. Offline applications are not mentioned; the notice says applications are accepted only online.

faq.question: Q7. Who can apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only eligible women can apply, and each must be a local resident of the village or urban ward where the Anganwadi centre is located.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Anganwadi Worker vacancy?
faq.answer: The single Anganwadi Worker post is at the Jholarao Anganwadi centre under Integrated Child Development Project Manpur.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for a Helper post at any centre?
faq.answer: Helper posts are at Bajipadar, Dendupadar-2, Kuhimal, Mungapadar, Manjhipara, Gavarmund, Pathari, Khajrayan, Kholapara and Dongaripara, one at each. The applicant must be a local resident of the village or ward where that centre is located.
